_comment: GENERATOR-AUTHORED crown marks for Cap 2. Defined as EXPLICIT CELLS in sprite coordinates, not as art on a rectangle — CAP2_FRONT_MOTIF_SAFE_MASK is authoritative and every cell below is checked against it. Thin strokes only: the previous filled star/heart/shield style read as blobs at gameplay scale. Value is step 1 (81), dark against the light crown.
